ai.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
ai.brief: Vercel Labs has released agent-desktop , an open-source CLI for AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux. agent-desktop reads each app through the operating system’s accessibility tree, not through screenshots. An agent gets a JSON snapshot with a ref for every element it can act on. 0. For developers, any shell-capable coding agent can now drive native apps without a vision model. TL;DR Library: Rust CLI and a C library. 60 command names, 56 operational . 04+ , on x64 and ARM64. Plain CPU, no GPU. Performance: Deterministic, retry-safe ref actions. No independent computer-use benchmark yet. Best: 78% to 96% fewer tokens on dense Electron apps via skeleton traversal ( self-reported ). What is agent-desktop? agent-desktop is a Rust CLI and C library from Vercel Labs for reading and operating desktop apps. It is a tool that agents call, not an agent .
